membership_count_semantics: Milestone membership counts overlap and are not task counts, effort estimates, or an exclusive partition of the census.

roadmap.scope: PC-88VA boot and media contract from cited evidence; specification only.
Deterministic host-built FAT12 filesystem and image assembly; no VA bootability claim.
First PC-88VA compile-only target, stub HAL, and DBCS on/off build matrix.
IPL reaches the first controlled instruction under VAEG.
FAT loader reads and transfers control to the kernel entry point.
Memory, timer and clock, interrupt, and runtime foundation.
Writable DOS session, clock, AUTOEXEC, and system transfer.
Japanese input and DBCS filename behavior.
Optional SASI/SCSI HDD extension; not on the boot-critical path.
Release gate, provenance, documentation, CI, and license decision.

rules.description: Leave an unknown census surface without an automatic milestone destination.
rules.notes: No automatic milestone route is justified until the observation is classified.

rules.description: Route explicit SASI, SCSI, or HDD evidence to the optional HDD extension.
rules.notes: M18 requires explicit tracked-source HDD evidence and is never a catch-all.

rules.description: Route explicit boot-sector, BPB, FAT12, or image-layout evidence.
rules.notes: M05 is limited to host-side filesystem and image layout work.

rules.description: Route explicit IPL entry and first-controlled-instruction evidence.
rules.notes: The contract precedes the M07 emulator-controlled IPL entry gate.

rules.description: Route explicit FAT loader, kernel load, or transfer evidence.
rules.notes: M08 owns FAT loading and transfer to the kernel entry point.

rules.description: Retain unmatched boot observations as boot-contract candidates.
rules.notes: Candidate consumers, not exclusive ownership or task counts.

rules.description: Route disk reads coupled to a boot loader.
rules.notes: The same observation informs the M04 contract and M08 loader implementation.

rules.description: Route explicit floppy writes, formatting, or media-change handling.
rules.notes: Write and media-change behavior is deferred to M14 after read-only support.

rules.description: Route explicit fdkernel floppy and FDC read-path evidence.
rules.notes: M12 is the kernel floppy read-only implementation candidate.

rules.description: Keep a generic disk observation at the media-contract boundary.
rules.notes: A generic disk token is insufficient to choose loader, read, write, or HDD work.

rules.description: Keep a generic DMA or FDC observation at the hardware-contract boundary.
rules.notes: Generic DMA evidence does not imply M18 or a particular read/write stage.

rules.description: Route Japanese console-output evidence to general and Japanese output stages.
rules.notes: General console output precedes Japanese glyph and NLS runtime validation.

rules.description: Route general console output to M09.
rules.notes: M07 may use diagnostics but does not own the final console subsystem.

rules.description: Route Japanese console-input evidence to general and Japanese input stages.
rules.notes: Japanese input and DBCS filename behavior follows the general keyboard path.

rules.description: Route general keyboard and console input to M11.
rules.notes: General console input is not a loader responsibility.

rules.description: Route NLS/DBCS evidence in build configuration files to the M06 matrix.
rules.notes: Compile-matrix routing does not claim Japanese runtime completion.

rules.description: Route NLS/DBCS input, parsing, editing, and filename evidence to M17.
rules.notes: M17 owns Japanese input and DBCS filename behavior.

rules.description: Route Country, NLS, codepage, and output-table evidence to M16.
rules.notes: M16 owns Japanese output and NLS runtime behavior.

rules.description: Keep an otherwise generic NLS/DBCS observation as a runtime candidate.
rules.notes: The coarse route excludes M06 unless build-matrix evidence is present.

rules.description: Route explicit host-side image-layout build evidence to M05.
rules.notes: Generic compiler and make conditionals are excluded from M05.

rules.description: Route platform selection, compiler configuration, HAL selection, and build structure to M06.
rules.notes: M06 is the first milestone allowed to add a PC-88VA compile-only target.

rules.description: Route memory/startup observations within boot code to loader handoff work.
rules.notes: Boot memory state is contracted in M04 and consumed by the M08 handoff.

rules.description: Route compile, link, segment, and startup layout evidence to M06.
rules.notes: M06 establishes the compile/link/startup shape before runtime foundation work.

rules.description: Route general memory behavior to the M10 runtime foundation.
rules.notes: Candidate consumers, not exclusive ownership or task counts.

rules.description: Route timer and clock behavior to the M10 runtime foundation.
rules.notes: M15 receives clock writes only through a specific writable-session rule.

rules.description: Route interrupt observations in boot code through the entry-state contract.
rules.notes: Boot interrupt state is a contract input to the later runtime foundation.

rules.description: Route general interrupt behavior to the M10 runtime foundation.
rules.notes: Candidate consumers, not exclusive ownership or task counts.

rules.description: Route firmware disk evidence in boot code to the loader stage.
rules.notes: The firmware ABI is contracted before the loader consumes it.

rules.description: Route firmware-coupled early console evidence to M09.
rules.notes: M04 defines the diagnostic route; M09 implements the console subsystem.

rules.description: Keep generic firmware evidence at the M04 contract boundary.
rules.notes: A generic firmware hit is not broadcast across implementation milestones.

rules.description: Route console, video, display, and printer device initialization to M09.
rules.notes: Device initialization follows the identified console-output subsystem.

rules.description: Route keyboard and input device initialization to M11.
rules.notes: Device initialization follows the identified console-input subsystem.

rules.description: Route generic device initialization to the M10 runtime foundation.
rules.notes: Storage, console, and input-specific rules take precedence over this default.

rules.description: Route explicit writable commands, AUTOEXEC, clock writes, and system transfer to M15.
rules.notes: M15 owns writable DOS session behavior rather than the read-only command gate.

rules.description: Route Japanese command-line and filename evidence to command and Japanese runtime stages.
rules.notes: Read-only command integration and Japanese runtime concerns are separate consumers.

rules.description: Route general COMMAND.COM and EXEC behavior to the M13 read-only session.
rules.notes: General EXEC runtime is not a keyboard milestone.
